candidates.status: conditional current and historical source-contract finding; central must reconcile aliases and count
candidates.first_failed_contract: The build assigns locations for structurally selected encounter IDs and quest dialogue templates using textual searches for a reserialized value rather than the parsed field location. The emitted identity/path can therefore disagree with the selected token, or an otherwise parsed spelling can fail lookup.
candidates.trace: Historical build.rs 164–173 and current 166–175 search raw encounter text from its beginning for each encoded ID; historical 360–382 and current 362–384 search quest text from a cursor for the next encoded template value. In a document whose earlier different scalar has the same encoded bytes, that earlier scalar can be selected; encounter source line and quest SourceRef line/column can identify the wrong token. If the raw token spelling differs from the serializer output and the searched encoded bytes do not occur in the searched text, the lookup panics before the subsequent validator (current 183 or 123); this is a conditional mathematical consequence, not a claim about actual authored content.
candidates.connected_consumer: The quest path compiles document/index -> variant ID at quest_catalog.rs 343–375, exposes it at 726–727, and selected referral handling serializes the source at dialogue_provenance.rs 98–123. SourceRef retains file, line, column, path and value_json at dialogue lib.rs 455–463. Road source() reads its embedded source map at road_encounter_catalog.rs 1036–1038; downstream use not established.
candidates.boundaries: An actual valid document, occurrence of mislocation, escaped spelling, publication, player-visible behavior and full source-map consumer set are not established; no input fixture, generation or execution. Item locator has its own keyed/cursor semantics and is not equated here. A difference between valid JSON lexeme and reserialized spelling is a condition, not an asserted committed data example.

These are assertions consistent with stated design intent, not proof of behavior or verification.

lens_perspectives.observation: Bounded quest and encounter source-location paths plus selected referral source retention; body injury summary through consumers remains subject to existing current record.
AnimationPackId is shared and open; selected item validator applies a boundary grammar. StrategicMinute and speed owners exist; do not invent closed pack enumeration.
Public serde/pathology and BodyInjury surfaces expose primitive fields; actual ordinary producers and validation remain open. Source-map search condition is source based.
Bounded autopsy sort/truncate, clamped quality and elapsed arithmetic; count/order policy and finite inputs need ownership. No forced 10000 handling cap.
Scene/custody flags and source location/path/value can be inconsistent unless producers maintain relationships; scene claim already separately traced.
Pack identity is shared core item/tactical vocabulary; source coordinates and parsed structural path require connected ownership, no wholesale ownership conclusion.
Parsed value and reserialized text search are separately computed to identify a source token; previously traced corpse scene assertion has conditional evidence-authority concern.
Current build adds only a unit_interval module import relative to selected P16 file; preserve authored identity, location and behavior through any later repair. Test text not runtime proof.
Melee movement and attack classification are enums; corpse flags and projectile boolean may encode intentional distinctions. No forced redesign based only on shape.
Pack has manual display/debug/conversion around an open Cow; any derive substitution must preserve wire/debug/borrowing behavior; no unnecessary-boilerplate defect established.
Open pack IDs and signed versus nonnegative speed distinguish semantic roles; supported animation-pack names do not close the vocabulary.
Item/encounter IDs, source paths, native JSON tokens and player-facing wording serve different contracts; source-ref parser bug is not a claim that every raw string is a bespoke owner.

Autopsy has named time/count limits and separate anatomical positions, damage/quality thresholds and unit conversions; producers, owners and intent remain open rather than treating every literal as a defect.
